title: Naturality of normalized constant scalar maps
statement: Let $i:D\to T$ be any morphism of schemes, $R,S$ commutative rings and $\varphi:R\to S$. Suppose $\eta_D:R_D\to\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi}S_D$ and $\eta_T:R_T\to\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi}S_T$ send every constant-presheaf generator $r$ to $\varphi(r)$. Then $\eta_T$ followed by the restricted supported constant unit equals the supported constant R-unit followed by $i_*\eta_D$ and the inverse canonical restriction-of-scalars/pushforward comparison. The supported constant unit is [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary].

source.place: Tags 06YN and 06YY, with etale-cohomology.tex Tag 03QP; scalar-extension paragraph of lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map

proof.text: The unit equation for uniqueness of left adjoints shows that the transpose of the constant pullback comparison preserves constant generators at the terminal etale object. Naturality transports the equation to every etale object.
The two composites agree on generators: both carry r to the constant section varphi(r) on the pullback object. The universal property of sheafification proves equality.

lean.statement: theorem supported_kummer_scalar_source_naturality {R S : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) {D T : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ T) (ηD : ordinaryFiniteConstant R D ⟶ (Sheaf.restrictScalars D.smallEtaleTopology φ).obj (ordinaryFiniteConstant S D)) (ηT : ordinaryFiniteConstant R T ⟶ (Sheaf.restrictScalars T.smallEtaleTopology φ).obj (ordinaryFiniteConstant S T)) (hD : ∀ (U : D.Etaleᵒᵖ) (r : R), ηD.hom.app U ((toSheafify D.smallEtaleTopology ((Functor.const D.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj (ModuleCat.of R R))).app U r) = (toSheafify D.smallEtaleTopology ((Functor.const D.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj (ModuleCat.of S S))).app U (φ r)) (hT : ∀ (U : T.Etaleᵒᵖ) (r : R), ηT.hom.app U ((toSheafify T.smallEtaleTopology ((Functor.const T.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj (ModuleCat.of R R))).app U r) = (toSheafify T.smallEtaleTopology ((Functor.const T.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj (ModuleCat.of S S))).app U (φ r)) : ηT ≫ (Sheaf.restrictScalars T.smallEtaleTopology φ).map (supportedConstantUnit S i) = supportedConstantUnit R i ≫ (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) i).map ηD ≫ (lowerStarCompRestrictScalarsIso φ i).inv.app (ordinaryFiniteConstant S D)
